user.description: Choose a Bluetooth beacon that Home Assistant has heard, or enter its MAC address.

manual.description: Enter the beacon's Bluetooth MAC address, for example C0:FF:EE:00:12:34. Its readings appear once a Bluetooth proxy hears its data, usually within a few minutes.

error.invalid_address: Enter the address as six pairs of hex digits separated by colons.

abort.already_configured: This beacon is already set up.
abort.not_supported: This device sends data in a format this integration doesn't read yet.
